title: Samsung Android 15 devices must have a Mobile Threat Detection (MTD) app installed.
check_content:
Confirm that an MTD app is installed on managed Samsung Android devices.

This check procedure is performed on both the device management tool and the Samsung Android device.

In the MDM console, verify that an MTD app is listed as a managed app being deployed to site managed devices.

On the Samsung Android device:

1. Open the Settings app.
2. Tap "Apps" and then "See all apps".
3. Verify that an MTD app is listed.

If an MTD app is not installed on the device, this is a finding.
fixtext: Install an MTD app on managed Samsung Android devices.
VulnDiscussion:
DOD mobile devices are in constant risk of cyber threats. MTD apps mitigate these risks by providing real-time threat detection, malware prevention, and vulnerability analysis.

SFR ID: FMT_MOF_EXT.1.2 #47
